decision_framework.prefer_five_seed_if: offline quality or stability improves materially and a roughly five-fold discovery cost is acceptable
decision_framework.prefer_guarded_over_native_if: guarded route adds no more than 25 percent overhead, rejects low-confidence points, and does not reduce quality by more than 0.02
decision_framework.runtime_rule: five_seed_stable is offline-only; do not place it in the online production path

production_status: The existing hierarchical PCA SFCM production path is unchanged; these three UMAP/HDBSCAN routes are research comparisons only.

protocol.raw_pca_neighborhood: reported baseline, not a fourth route
protocol.route_baseline: existing single-run UMAP -> HDBSCAN discovery path
